title: Meridia — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Southern Star Atlas. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Southern Star Atlas
options.lineage: engraved celestial atlases and star catalogues
options.thesis: A curated portfolio is a small catalogue of named objects. Each house is an entry with coordinates, a magnitude and a season — and going south is literally seeing a different sky. The surface is read at night, in winter, which is when this audience actually buys.
options.viewport: A dark chart plane holding one property as a plotted entry: its coordinates, its latitude, the hours of winter sun it gets, and one full-bleed photograph revealed as you move through the plate.
options.risk: A dark ground plus a warm accent is one keystroke away from the luxury-real-estate cliché. It has to read as an engraved chart, not as a glowing dark-mode UI.

options.label: Night Flight Instruments
options.lineage: a small aircraft's night instrument six-pack
options.thesis: Six calm dials that agree with each other, holding trust when there is nothing outside the glass.
options.case: Fuses well: the buyer has never stood in the room, so every gauge is a thing they cannot verify themselves — sun hours, flight time, sea distance, winter temperature. The forensic second pass made into the whole interface.

options.label: Brick Build Instructions
options.lineage: numbered exploded steps on sky-blue pages
options.thesis: Wordless arrows and 1:1 call-outs teaching assembly, step by numbered step.
options.case: Fuses only halfway: buying abroad genuinely is a numbered sequence of steps, and this world teaches sequence better than any other. But it renders houses as parts in a kit, which works against a purchase this audience makes emotionally.

options.label: Street Typography
options.lineage: public theater street posters, wood-type capitals
options.thesis: Architectural-scale wood type on diagonals, words cropped by the edge like crowd noise.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it shouts, and this decision is made quietly over three months. It would also bury the photographs, which are the only real evidence this product has.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What luxury holiday-home sites ship, executed impeccably: a full-bleed pool at golden hour, a restrained serif, a filter bar, generous white space.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every competitor, by design.
